title: PayloadRejectedPayload
description: Payload of the PayloadRejected event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

validationTrace.description: The payload-build validation trace (opaque to this envelope; interpreted by console-bff and notification-svc).
